conversations.prompt: Could you replace Col and Row from AntD with Material UI substitue
conversations.answer: ChatGPTCertainly! In Material-UI, the substitute for the Col and Row components from AntD is the Grid component. Here's how you can refactor your code to replace AntD's Col and Row with Material-UI's Grid:[CODE_BLOCK_0]Changes:Imported Grid from @material-ui/core/Grid.Replaced the <Row> component with a <Grid container>.Replaced the <Col span={24}> component with a <Grid item xs={12}>.Material-UI's Grid component works with a 12-column grid system by default, so xs={12} means the grid item will take the full width on extra small screens and larger. If you need it to adapt differently for other screen sizes, you can use the sm, md, lg, and xl props.
